Thirty-eight new occurrences of "cell" in history_bake.rs. In this repo a cell is a mesh VERTEX, a POINT where fields are sampled; GIS convention makes it an AREA and the guard exists to stop that sense creeping in. Use `Vertex` for the point and `Facet` for the patch — the vocabulary is fixed in book/src/reference/lexicon-of-place.md. If any of them really IS an area (a lattice square, a chart square, an inflection-table cell) the guard takes a waiver on the line:

    // lexicon: <why this one is an area>

and it says outright that a waiver with no reason is a failure rather than a pass.
